record.question: The International Programme on the Elimination of Child Labour (IPEC) was initiated by which organization in 1992?
record.explanation: Answer B: International Labour Organization (ILO). The International Labour Organization launched IPEC in 1992. Reference: https://www.ilo.org/ipec/programme/lang--en/index.htm. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: Tutor & Warden Paper-IV, January 2026 examination.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
